target_customer: Small and mid-size life science labs and biotechs
problem: Labs overpay for supplies and scientists waste time on purchasing; HappiLabs supplied PhD-level virtual lab managers to handle procurement, inventory and compliance.
business_model: Subscription service plus software, priced per virtual lab manager hours

founders.name: Tom Ruginis
founders.background_notes: Also worked as a lab manager per TechCrunch 2018.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly services with a price database and dashboards; software was just being added in 2018.

defensibility.rationale: A price database and trained staff help, but the service is labor based and copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Science Exchange acquired it in March 2025 and keeps the team and Virtual Lab Manager product.

market_need_then: Ruginis saw large price gaps for identical supplies while selling for a distributor; by 2018 it served 26 labs and earned $1M in 2017.

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission framed as improving scientists' happiness

brand_strength.rationale: Name signals happiness for scientists and was used in a #AskHappiLabs membership, but there is no press on the brand and similar names exist.

pivots.why: TechCrunch reported it was looking at adding software and seeking a CTO

outcome_analysis: HappiLabs bootstrapped from $20,000 in 2012, earned $1M in 2017, and took YC's standard $120,000 in 2018 to add software. It stayed a small services business and was acquired by Science Exchange in March 2025, with Ruginis taking a senior role. The founder's distributor background and capital efficiency fit the outcome; deal terms are not public.
notes: happilabs.org now redirects to Science Exchange (not opened further). The $120K is YC's standard deal, recorded as other because TechCrunch reports the amount. CB Insights $370K total including a 2020 loan is aggregator only, unverified. TechCrunch named no competitors; Quartzy and Scientist.com appear in undated vendor pages so were omitted. Founding year 2012 (TechCrunch, YC) vs 2013 (Crunchbase).
